metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: A high-energy ensemble workplace comedy that matches the optimistic yet zany vibe of Community and Scrubs.

metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: A quintessential 'comfort' show with an uplifting heart similar to Ted Lasso and The Good Place.

metas.name: 30 Rock
metas.description: Fast-paced, joke-dense writing that appeals to fans of Community and Silicon Valley's sharp wit.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: A wholesome yet hilarious family dynamic that captures the grounded charm of King of the Hill and The Simpsons.

metas.name: Archer
metas.description: Stylized animation and cynical humor that will appeal to fans of Futurama and Rick and Morty.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: A heartwarming 'fish out of water' story with excellent character growth similar to Ted Lasso.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A mockumentary about vampires that blends supernatural elements with the absurd humor of It's Always Sunny.

metas.name: Solar Opposites
metas.description: Created by the team behind Rick and Morty, offering the same sci-fi absurdity and high-concept comedy.

metas.name: Arrested Development
metas.description: A brilliant ensemble comedy featuring complex running gags similar to the layered humor of Community.

metas.name: Abbott Elementary
metas.description: A modern mockumentary that is light, funny, and incredibly easy to watch, much like New Girl.

metas.name: Superstore
metas.description: An easy-to-digest workplace sitcom that captures the relatable retail experience with a Scrubs-like ensemble.

metas.name: Star Trek: Lower Decks
metas.description: An animated sci-fi comedy that celebrates and pokes fun at the genre, perfect for a Futurama fan.

metas.name: Taskmaster
metas.description: A British reality competition that is pure, chaotic fun, matching the lighthearted energy of Gogglebox.

metas.name: Spaced
metas.description: A British comedy filled with pop-culture references and surrealism that feels like a precursor to Community.

metas.name: Kim's Convenience
metas.description: A warm, funny family sitcom that provides the same 'background' comfort as King of the Hill.

metas.name: Ghosts (UK)
metas.description: A charming and funny ensemble piece about a group of ghosts that shares the warmth of The Good Place.

metas.name: Our Flag Means Death
metas.description: A whimsical and inclusive pirate adventure that fits the 'fun action' vibe of One Piece.

metas.name: Black Books
metas.description: A cynical, surreal British comedy that pairs excellently with Peep Show and It's Always Sunny.

metas.name: Mob Psycho 100
metas.description: From the creator of One-Punch Man, it offers the same mix of incredible action and deadpan comedy.

metas.name: Peacemaker
metas.description: A bold, funny, and action-packed superhero show that matches the tone of Fallout and One-Punch Man.

metas.name: The Mick
metas.description: Stars Kaitlin Olson from It's Always Sunny in a similarly degenerate and hilarious family dynamic.

metas.name: Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt
metas.description: A vibrant, fast-paced, and relentlessly positive comedy from the creators of 30 Rock.

metas.name: Better Off Ted
metas.description: A short-lived cult classic corporate satire that matches the sharp wit of Silicon Valley and Community.

metas.name: Avenue 5
metas.description: A sci-fi comedy about a luxury space cruise gone wrong, appealing to fans of Futurama and Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Detroiters
metas.description: A deeply silly and warm-hearted show about two best friends, capturing the 'hangout' vibe of New Girl.

metas.name: The Venture Bros.
metas.description: A clever, long-running animation that parodies adventure tropes, perfect for fans of Rick and Morty and Futurama.
